title: mview Markdown reading
brief: Comfortable reading for the Markdown view (S15): larger text and line height, headings that separate sections, more space between paragraphs and list items, inside the unchanged Workbench shell. Content: S13–S15, the Server contract and the start of ## Tasks of odd/tasks/mview.md; light/dark and 1440/800 px switches; every value listed in an artboard-only Values panel.

artboards.title: Sans
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps today's system sans everywhere, so it feels like the same app, only larger (17px/1.7, 680px column); less of a 'reading' feel on long prose than a serif

artboards.title: Serif
artboards.tradeoff: Book-like body (Iowan/Palatino 19px/1.7, 720px column) with sans headings, code and tables: strongest reading comfort and heading contrast; looks less like the rest of the tool and Iowan is macOS-only (Palatino/Georgia elsewhere)
